product.name: AI Copilot for Performance Marketing
product.description: An AI assistant that helps media buyers make timely decisions to optimize ad performance across platforms like Google Ads and Meta Ads.

product.name: Multi-Agent Framework for Data Retrieval
product.description: A system of AI agents that collaboratively fetch and process only the essential data needed to answer marketing queries in real time.

product.name: AI-Powered Reporting
product.description: Automated generation of marketing performance reports using AI to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.

product.name: Privacy-First Analytics Platform (Crux)
product.description: An analytics platform that ensures data privacy by processing only metadata and running queries on-premise without exposing raw data.
